ModMetaData.name: Ordered Work (Core)
ModMetaData.author: nightmare123487
ModMetaData.description: Work Control (0.3.0-alpha.7). The vanilla Work tab can now be edited manually above priority 4. A clean-room Harmony prefix replaces the capable priority cell: left-click cycles 0..max (max = max(4, visible capable WorkTypes), capped at 99, falling back to 99 if the dynamic count fails), right-click decrements, and values above 4 are drawn as a distinct blue box with a cyan number and a tooltip. Priorities 0..4 still use the vanilla priority colours. SetPriority is normalised to the dynamic range and now notifies once; the existing vanilla capture rebuilds the stored per-pawn order, while our own Apply is excluded through the IsApplying guard. The Work Control tab is unchanged: rows of free colonists, flat single-line cards with passion icon, level, name and delete, flexible filtering search, Draw/Manual/Both modes, pinned/scored recommendations, game-start initialization and respawn guards. No profiles, schedules or equipment yet. Do not use in a main save; back up your save first.
